text:
maria: Heads up — Q2 marketing promos will overlap with EU region launch next month. Forecast looks like +2.8x peak RPS for a ~48h window around launch. We should recheck autoscaler guardrails; last time we saw cold starts +4x GPU-hour burn. Can ops/infra take a look? @aj @lee
aj: Ack, saw the spike in the forecast. Do we use per-customer burst credits or bump steady-state reserve for eu? :thinking:
lee: My initial thought: keep a small steady reserve (6 GPUs) in eu-west for 72h around the launch and cap burst to a percentage of remaining capacity. Also tighten cooldowns to avoid flapping with marketing traffic bursts.
sophie: FYI cost calc — reserving 6 GPUs for 72h is ~ $5.4k. That's cheaper than uncontrolled preemptible churn + egress surprises.
maria: Can you draft the exact autoscaler policy we should apply? Need fields we can paste into the deploy PR.
aj: Draft below, feel free to iterate:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  mode: hybrid
  steady_reserve:
    region: eu-west-1
    gpus: 6
    duration_seconds: 259200 # 72h
  burst:
    max_percent_of_capacity: 25
    credit_window_seconds: 14400 # 4h
    max_burst_concurrent_gpus: 12
  cooldown_seconds: 300
  scale_in_window_seconds: 600
  scale_out_concurrency: 2
  preemptible_mix:
    allowed: true
    max_preemptible_percent: 40
    fallback_policy: "spill-to-dedicated"
```
lee: Couple quick notes: - prefer credit_window=7200s (2h) to limit long burst debt. - reduce max_burst_concurrent_gpus to 10 to keep tail latency stable. - add a route policy to avoid cross-region spill unless eu is saturated.
aj: Updated suggestion: credit_window_seconds: 7200, max_burst_concurrent_gpus: 10. And add route_policy: prefer_spot_when_steady_exhausted.
sophie: Also propose adding an autoscale-label `autoscale-snooze=true` for low-priority batch workers during the 72h window so they don't fight for GPUs with foreground inference.
ops-bot: deploy plan created: rollout/autoscale/eu-q2-guardrails -> canary 10% -> full 100% in 30m (deploy id: dp-98431) :rocket:
maria: Nice. @lee can you own canary watch and validation? If we see >15% tail-latency regressions we rollback immediately.
lee: On it. I'll post the perf dashboard link and set an alert: `eu-promo-sla-tail > 15%` -> paging. (reacted :eyes:)
aj: One more item: add a temporary cost-alert channel rule for eu region if spend > $8k/day during the window.
sophie: Adding the budget alert to the cost channel now.
maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene 24h after canary to review metrics and decide whether to reduce the reserve.
aj: Quick follow-up — do we want a post-mortem playbook entry for this launch pattern? I can stub it if you want.
lee: Yes please, capture the decision tree: reserve vs credits vs manual top-up, plus rollback thresholds.
sophie: I'll attach cost numbers and the rough math to the PR.
maria: Awesome — closing loop. (reacted :thumbsup:)
